nameSource: itemInfo_UTF8.lub: officialId, identifiedDisplayName, identifiedDescriptionName, ResourceName/Icon, ClassNum/slotCount
equipmentSource: db/re/item_db_equip.yml: Type, SubType, Buy, Attack, MagicAttack, Defense, Range, Slots, Jobs, Classes, Locations, WeaponLevel, ArmorLevel, EquipLevelMin, Refineable, Gradable, View, Script/EquipScript/UnEquipScript
priceRule: buyPrice = DB_RE Buy; if Buy missing default 20. sellPrice = DB_RE Sell if present, otherwise floor(buyPrice / 2).
weaponTypeRule: weaponType is derived from DB_RE SubType; do not hand-enter or infer from Chinese description.
rangeRule: Normal attack range uses item Range first; data/weapon_types.json is fallback/default only. Skill range bonus will be added by skill data later.
scriptRule: Script/EquipScript/UnEquipScript are preserved as raw strings first; parser support is incremental.
compatibilityRule: Runtime may expose legacy aliases (id/name/buyPrice/atk/etc.) only through normalization. New source JSON and builders must use canonical fields.
